one_liner: Amazon SP-API is a broad REST API for seller/vendor data using Login with Amazon OAuth2; requires a Professional seller account, developer profile review, and role approvals.
auth_notes: Public apps are authorized by sellers/vendors via OAuth; private apps can self-authorize in draft status from the Solution Provider Portal. Refresh-token and LWA details are from general knowledge and not confirmed by the fetched pages.
access_notes: Only Professional selling accounts can develop against SP-API. You must register a developer profile that Amazon evaluates, and request and qualify for roles. Restricted roles need extra data-use and security information. Public apps must be listed in the Selling Partner Appstore. Sandbox endpoints are available. The pages do not confirm pricing.
blocker_notes: Professional seller account, developer profile review, and role approval are required. Public multi-user apps must also be listed in the Appstore.

evidence.quote: Applications that are publicly available and are authorized by sellers or by vendors using OAuth.
You can self-authorize your application in draft status; there is no need to publish a private application.
Only Professional Selling Accounts can register to develop or integrate with Selling Partner API.
As a developer, you must request and qualify for a particular role to gain access to the operations and resources that the role provides.

In accordance with the [Solution Provider Portal Agreement](https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/policies-and-agreements), public developers must list their app in the Amazon Selling Partner Appstore.
